posts.title: Account portability on the Fediverse vs. the ATmosphere
posts.description: You want to leave your server. What happens to your followers, your handle, and your posts? On the Fediverse, leaving is a move. In the ATmosphere, most switching isn't a move at all. A neutral look at how each network handles account portability, and the trade-offs behind each.

posts.title: Year of the Cockroach
posts.description: Meta suspended a San Francisco queer bar's Instagram. India ordered GitHub to delete a messaging app's source code. US prosecutors charged a man over a phone running GrapheneOS. Each time the target moves further down the stack, fewer people can route around it.

posts.title: The Fediverse Beyond Mastodon mini-series is complete. Here's everything.
posts.description: Four posts on what else runs on ActivityPub besides Mastodon: microblogging alternatives & forks, photo and video platforms, writing tools, forums, books, music, and more.
